sources.title: GitHub - broadinstitute/ABC-Enhancer-Gene-Prediction: Cell type ...
sources.snippet: Activity by Contact Model of Enhancer-Gene Specificity The Activity-by-Contact (ABC) model predicts which enhancers regulate which genes on a cell type specific basis. This repository contains the code needed to run the ABC model as well as small sample data files, example commands, and some general tips and suggestions.
